Owen's Sunday Sociable (Harrisburg Bicycle Club)

Harrisburg, PA · City Island · Social · Road

Owen's Sunday Sociable (Harrisburg Bicycle Club) is a social and road group ride in Harrisburg, PA. It rolls every Sunday at 7:15 am from City Island, main parking lot north of Market Street.

For visitors

Registration is not required. The leader says no rider is left behind and new people and young people are welcome. Some riders have breakfast at Roxy's Café on North St afterwards.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8 to 10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Owen's Sunday Sociable (Harrisburg Bicycle Club) group ride

An easy early-Sunday spin from City Island at 8 to 10 mph for about 75 minutes, before the traffic picks up. The leader says no rider is left behind. Breakfast at Roxy's Café follows for those who want it.
